 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Mirror each row horizontally and form three vertically reflected tiles."""
    h = len(grid)
    if not h:
        return []
    rows = list(reversed(grid)) + grid + list(reversed(grid))
    # The two joins at the reflected boundaries duplicate the end rows, as in
    # the demonstrated 3x vertical mirror tiling.
    rows = rows[:h] + grid[:1] + grid[1:] + list(reversed(grid))[:1] + list(reversed(grid))[1:]
    # Equivalent source-row index sequence: h-1..0, 0..h-1, h-1..0.
    # Construct directly to make the boundary duplication explicit.
    indices = list(range(h - 1, -1, -1)) + list(range(h)) + list(range(h - 1, -1, -1))
    return [list(reversed(grid[i])) + list(grid[i]) for i in indices]
"
}
